# netbox_ip_address (Data Source)

Retrieves a single ip address from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_ip_address" "ip_address" {
  id = 1001
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the ip address.

### Read-Only

- `address_family` (String) The address family of the ip address.
- `created` (String) The created of the ip address.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the ip address, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the ip address.
- `dns_name` (String) The DNS name of the ip address.
- `ip_address` (String) The IP address of the ip address, in CIDR notation.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the ip address.
- `role` (String) The role of the ip address.
- `status` (String) The status of the ip address.
- `tags` (List of Object) Tags to assign to the ip address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `tenant` (List of Object) The tenant of the ip address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenant))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `display` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)
